question: What will be the ending value of the UST 10Y Yield for these biweekly periods of Q3 2026? (Sep 21 - Oct 2)

calls.reasoning: Anchor: last print before the window is Fri 09/18 at 5.01 (Treasury par/DGS10) or 4.995-4.997 (Tradeweb/market close) - a 19-year high, second-highest close of the year. Reference class is the random-walk class of 10-business-day changes in the 10Y (median ~0, SD ~18bp in this vol regime), giving a base-rate median of ~5.01; the conditional Jul-Sep 2026 sub-class is strongly trending (16 overlapping 10-session windows, nearly all positive, median ~+20bp), but those are one autocorrelated oil/Fed episode and 10-day yield-change autocorrelation is near zero, so I take only ~2bp of drift rather than extrapolating. Sell-side agrees with the modest drift, not the extrapolation: JPM raised its year-end 10Y to 5.05% on 09/17 and Standard Bank to 5.2%, i.e. roughly flat-to-slightly-higher over 3.5 months. Two-sided risk is unusually live: escalation/oil above $109 and hawkish Warsh (25bp hike 09/16 to 3.75-4.00% with at least one more signalled) push up, while 5% has been repeatedly rejected (5.01 -> 4.94 -> 5.01 in three sessions, the 09/17 drop on softer oil), quarter-end extension buying and any de-escalation headline (cf. the early-August yield plunge on peace-talk hopes) push down; a soft September payroll print on 10/02 could move it 10bp+ before the 20:00Z cutoff. No shutdown risk - CR signed 09/02 funds through 12/11 - so data lands on schedule. Market check: harness found nothing on Polymarket/Manifold; Kalshi does run 10Y daily/weekly yield series (KXTNOTED/KXTNOTEW/KXUST10AD) but the pages returned 429 and the public API returned an empty market list, so I obtained no live human price and blended none - contract terms (which print, which cutoff) would in any case have needed checking against this question's unspecified source. The 5.255 upper bound sits only ~25bp above spot, a move this series has made repeatedly inside 10 sessions this quarter, so I price 11% escape above it; the lower bound is 150bp away and unreachable absent an unprecedented crisis rally, so no lower escape is declared.
